message.content:
To **log in** to PreLicenseTraining.com, go to the account login page and enter your **login name** and **password**.[1] The site notes that your login name may be your **email address** unless you created a different username.[1]

If you **forgot your password**, use the password reset page and enter the email address for the account you’re trying to access; the site will email reset instructions.[2]

If you want, I can also point you to the **student login**, **mentor portal**, or **password reset** page specifically.[3]
